text: Which second factor resists phishing structurally rather than merely making it harder?
choices: Hardware security keys using FIDO2/WebAuthn, because the key checks the origin
explanation: A user cannot be tricked into authenticating to a lookalike site because the key simply will not respond to the wrong origin. SMS is defeated by SIM swapping and SS7 interception; app codes can be relayed by a convincing proxy.
